newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 20.22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate falls to 20.22 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Friday, July 18, was fixed at 20.22 percent, or 76 basis points lower than the July 17 rate of 20.98 percent, Banco de Mexico said on Thursday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate, revised each working day. It is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Friday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
